# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Lab affected

Example:
labs/002-service-enumeration

## Type of change

- [ ] New lab
- [ ] Lab update
- [ ] Results upload
- [ ] Config update
- [ ] Detection update
- [ ] Documentation cleanup

## Safety check

- [ ] No real secrets committed
- [ ] No live systems modified by the agent
- [ ] Commands are scoped to owned lab systems
- [ ] Cleanup steps are included

## Reproducibility check

- [ ] Hardware required is listed
- [ ] Network topology is listed
- [ ] Setup steps are complete
- [ ] Expected outputs are included
- [ ] Results location is documented
